title: Identification of the published tensor comparison for one inverse image
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, and any scheme morphism f:X→Y. Let d_f be publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f. Use the systemClosed structures and systemTensorModel models of pullbackTensorCalculus to construct the ambient tensor comparison on the sequence site. For every M,N in coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y, d_f(T_Y(M,N));mu_ambient(f)(M,N) = mu_published(f)(M,N);T_X(d_f(M),d_f(N)). This identifies the two comparisons for one morphism, without a composition claim. proof.text: Identify the ordinary inverse-image presentations using sequence_inverse_eq. The ambient normalized ordinary comparison sends the unit of x tensor y to the tensor of the two units. Its inverse total chain comparison therefore satisfies the defining formula of pullbackTensorSequenceCochain on every summand; adjunction-unit injectivity and pure-tensor extensionality identify it with the published comparison.

Invert the ambient representative rectangle and insert the chain identification. The exact-localization and tensor-model isomorphisms give precisely the forward rectangle defining pullbackTensorSystemComparison. Restriction to flat-term K-flat pairs is faithful, so cancellation proves the stated comparison equation for arbitrary unbounded pairs. No sequence transition is inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem publishedSystemTensorIdentification {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y) :
    (WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app
        ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
      ((publishedSystemAmbientData l E).tensor f).hom.app (M, N) =
    (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M, N) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app M)
          ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app N))
